programs.name: supscontour
programs.purpose: Plot SU traces as PostScript contours using pscontour.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSCONTOUR - PostScript CONTOUR plot of a segy data set

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces
params.description: Number of traces; takes precedence over ntr.

params.name: ntr
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: tr.d1, else tr.dt/1000000, else 0.004 for seismic or 1.0 for nonseismic

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: tr.d2 if nonzero, otherwise 1.0

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: tr.f1, else tr.delrt/1000, else 0.0

params.name: f2
params.default: computed: tr.f2, else tr.tracr, else tr.tracl, else 1.0 for seismic or 0.0 for nonseismic

params.name: key
params.description: Header key supplying irregular slow-axis coordinates.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty string

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Axis values are converted to float and formatted with %f before passing them to pscontour. The irregular-coordinate string is read without explicitly adding a terminating NUL and is used with %s, causing undefined behavior; command-buffer and environment-string writes can also overflow. PostScript numerics depend on pscontour.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers traces and optionally constructs irregular coordinates from headers before invoking a plotting program.

test_cases.description: Use explicit dimensions and axis coordinates.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | supscontour n2=16 d1=0.004 d2=2 f1=0 f2=1

test_cases.description: Use trace headers for irregular coordinates.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | supscontour key=tracl verbose=1

programs.name: supscube
programs.purpose: Plot SU traces as a PostScript data cube using pscube.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSCUBE - PostScript CUBE plot of a segy data set

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: ntr/n3 if n3 supplied, otherwise ntr
params.description: Traces per frame; ntr comes from the first header or a count.

params.name: n3
params.default: computed: ntr/n2 if n2 supplied, otherwise 1
params.description: Number of frames; ntr comes from the first header or a count.

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: tr.d1, else tr.dt/1000000, else 0.004 for seismic or 1.0 for nonseismic

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: tr.d2 if nonzero, otherwise 1.0

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: tr.f1, else tr.delrt/1000, else 0.0

params.name: f2
params.default: computed: tr.f2, else tr.tracr, else tr.tracl, else 1.0 for seismic or 0.0 for nonseismic

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty string

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Axis values are converted to float and formatted with %f before passing them to pscube. f3 is fixed at 0.0; user-supplied f3 is discarded. Command-buffer and environment-string writes can overflow. PostScript numerics depend on pscube.
programs.difficulty_reason: It counts and buffers traces when needed, derives cube dimensions, and invokes a plotting program.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | supscube n2=4 n3=4 d3=2

test_cases.description: Count traces and derive the frame count.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | supscube n2=4 verbose=1 d1=0.004 d2=2

programs.name: supsgraph
programs.purpose: Plot SU traces as PostScript graphs using psgraph.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSGRAPH - PostScript GRAPH plot of a segy data set

params.name: style
params.default: seismic

params.name: nplot
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces
params.description: Number of traces; takes precedence over ntr.

params.name: ntr
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: for seismic, tr.dt/1000000 or 0.004; for nonseismic, tr.d1 or 1.0

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: tr.d2 if nonzero, otherwise 1.0
params.description: Read by the wrapper and forwarded if supplied.

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: for seismic, tr.delrt/1000 or 0.0; for nonseismic, tr.f1 or 0.0

params.name: f2
params.description: Read twice; the second read overrides the header-derived value when absent. Forwarded if supplied.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty string

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Axis values are converted to float and formatted with %f before passing them to psgraph. Command-buffer and environment-string writes can overflow. PostScript numerics depend on psgraph.
programs.difficulty_reason: It can buffer multiple traces to count them before invoking the graphing program.

test_cases.description: Use explicit plot count and normal style.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supsgraph nplot=8 style=normal d1=0.004 f1=0

programs.name: supsmax
programs.purpose: Plot the maximum, minimum, or absolute maximum of each SU trace as a PostScript graph.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSMAX - PostScript of the MAX, min, or absolute max value on each trace

params.name: mode
params.default: max
params.description: sumax mode: max, min, or abs.

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces
params.description: Number of traces; takes precedence over ntr.

params.name: ntr
params.default: computed: first trace ntr header, or count input traces

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: tr.d1, else tr.dt/1000000, else 0.004 for seismic or 1.0 for nonseismic
params.description: Read by the wrapper and forwarded if supplied.

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: tr.d2 if nonzero, otherwise 1.0
params.description: Read by the wrapper and forwarded if supplied.

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: tr.f1, else tr.delrt/1000, else 0.0
params.description: Read by the wrapper and forwarded if supplied.

params.name: f2
params.default: computed: tr.f2, else tr.tracr, else tr.tracl, else 1.0 for seismic or 0.0 for nonseismic
params.description: Read by the wrapper and forwarded if supplied.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty string

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Numerical output depends on sumax and psgraph. When the trace count is already known, headerfp remains NULL but is unconditionally passed to efclose, causing undefined behavior. Command-buffer and environment-string writes can overflow.
programs.difficulty_reason: It can buffer trace headers and samples separately before piping reconstructed traces through two programs.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | supsmax mode=max verbose=1
